packageRules.description: Automerge non-major + patch updates if CI passes
Major updates: open PR, no automerge — human review
Group Go module bumps so we don’t spam
Group Helm chart deps + values defaults
Group OpenTofu / Terraform deps under one PR
Pin Docker base images to digest — ADR-0015 supply-chain hygiene
golangci/golangci-lint is the binary version (with: version: vX.Y.Z) read by golangci-lint-action, not a Git ref. It cannot be digest-pinned; the action only accepts a release tag string.
kubernetes 1.x dependencies in go.mod — keep on minor channel

The kind CLI and the kindest/node image move together: the harness creates the cluster with the CLI, and a node image newer than the CLI supports fails in kubeadm init (kindest/node v1.37 needs kind v0.33+).

semantic-release and its plugins (package.json): never automerge. The release job only runs on main, so no PR check exercises the publish path; a floating conventionalcommits minor already broke one release. `make verify-release-notes` covers analyze + notes on the PR.

conventional-changelog-conventionalcommits 10.x renders empty release notes with semantic-release 24 and 25 (both bundle release-notes-generator 14, which ships conventional-changelog-writer 8). Hold it on 9.x until semantic-release moves to writer 9; `make verify-release-notes` proves any bump.

The go.mod `go` directive is a deliberate security FLOOR (CVE fixes on OIDC/x509 paths), not a version to chase: raising it forces every consumer and tool (e.g. the Go that golangci-lint was built with) up with it. Toolchain bumps stay enabled.

The go.mod `toolchain` directive (a security floor) and the golang builder image in Dockerfile.bridge / Dockerfile.plugin move in one PR. The image sets GOTOOLCHAIN=local, so its Go builds the release binaries, and hack/toolchaincheck fails the Docker build (and `go test`) when the image is older than the toolchain line. Grouped, a toolchain bump never waits for a separate image PR. Placed after the gomod group rule so it overrides that group for the toolchain; the `go` directive (also depName `go`) stays disabled by the rule above.

The Nexus e2e (test/e2e/nexus/Dockerfile, ADR-0036 decision i) pins Sonatype Nexus Repository to 3.76.1, the last Community Edition release without the EULA gate. 3.77 and later refuse service until an operator accepts the EULA, a legal act this project never performs on anyone's behalf, so a bump past 3.76 is a maintainer decision (ADR-0036 question 4), not a dependency update.

controller-gen stamps its version into the CRDs (controller-gen.kubebuilder.io/version). A bump fails `make verify-generated` until someone runs `make generate manifests` and commits the result, so it never automerges.

customManagers.description: Resolve versions stored in OpenTofu/Terraform variable defaults or named locals that the native terraform manager can't follow. Annotate the assignment with a `# renovate:` comment on the line directly above it; the comment is the anchor, so any `<name> = "..."` line (a `default = ...` or a `local`-block assignment) is tracked.
Tool versions in workflow `with:` inputs (e.g. helm/kind-action's `version`). Annotate the input with a `# renovate:` comment on the line directly above it.
Tool versions in the Makefile (`NAME_VERSION ?= vX.Y.Z`). Annotate the assignment with a `# renovate:` comment on the line directly above it.
